projection.name: scylladb
projection.title: ScyllaDB
projection.description: ScyllaDB cockpit: keyspaces and tables, editable CQL grids, a CQL console, a live token-ring and shard-per-core topology map, per-table compaction/cache/latency metrics, nodetool-style cluster status, and a CQL tracing viewer.

fields.label: Contact points
fields.help: Comma or newline separated ScyllaDB contact points.

fields.label: Local datacenter
fields.help: Enables datacenter-aware, token-aware, shard-aware routing when set.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable ScyllaDB password. The credential identity can also supply the username.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM containing the client certificate and private key for mTLS.

fields.label: Connections per host
fields.help: Set at least one connection per shard so every core is reachable without the shard-aware port.

fields.label: Use the shard-aware port
fields.help: Connects to the node's shard-aware port (CQL port + 10000) to land one connection on every shard deterministically. The gateway egress policy must allow that extra port.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, BATCH, DDL, TRUNCATE, and privilege changes.

fields.label: Confirm destructive statements
fields.help: Requires explicit confirmation before writes, DDL, batches, truncates, and privilege changes execute.

fields.label: Redacted columns
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for result columns that must be masked.

fields.label: Replication class
fields.help: ScyllaDB rejects SimpleStrategy for tablet-replicated keyspaces; prefer NetworkTopologyStrategy.

fields.label: Tablets
fields.help: Tablets let ScyllaDB rebalance data per table instead of per node.

fields.label: Initial tablets
fields.help: Leave empty to let ScyllaDB pick the initial tablet count.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this keyspace? Every table, view, type, and all data within it will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this type? Tables and columns that use it must already be gone.

fields.label: Primary key
fields.help: CQL primary key expression, for example id or ((tenant_id, bucket), created_at).

actions.label: Drop column
actions.confirmText: Drop this column? Its data is permanently removed.

fields.label: Column
fields.help: A ScyllaDB secondary index covers a single column.

fields.label: Local index
fields.help: Restricts the index to each partition, avoiding a global index materialized view.

actions.label: Drop index
actions.confirmText: Drop this index? Queries relying on it will start failing.

actions.label: Truncate
actions.confirmText: Truncate this table? Every partition and row will be deleted on every replica.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this table? The table definition and data will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this materialized view? It will stop being maintained and its data is removed.

fields.label: Partition key
fields.help: One entry per partition-key column. Values are bound as CQL parameters and the coordinator computes the token.

actions.label: Trace a statement
actions.confirmText: Run this statement on the cluster with server-side tracing enabled? Tracing adds load and writes rows to system_traces.

fields.label: CQL
fields.help: The statement runs once on the cluster with server-side tracing enabled.

config.emptyText: The coordinator has not flushed this trace yet.
